target_customer: Software engineering teams running many AI coding agents who want shared visibility and control
problem: Teams running dozens of coding agents lose track of their work and decisions; Linzumi puts agents inside team chat channels so work can be started, reviewed and unblocked together.
business_model: SaaS subscription: free personal tier, company tier listed at 100 USD per month
product_category: Team chat for AI coding agents

founders.name: Sean Grove
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a 3x YC founder and says he worked on post-training and alignment research at OpenAI; education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Chat plus orchestration of agents running on user machines, with a planned knowledge compiler, is standard engineering with some hard integration parts; the product initially worked with Codex only.

defensibility.rationale: Chat tools hold team history and decisions, which can create lock-in, but agent vendors and chat incumbents can add similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Slack launched Slack Code, a channel type for coding agents, on 2026-08-20 with Anthropic, Cognition, GitHub, OpenAI and Vercel as partners, after the Spring 2026 batch.

market_need_then: Coding agents were spreading quickly in 2026, and teams needed shared coordination around them.

identity.mascot_or_character: Mouse characters used across site illustrations
identity.visual_style: Illustrated scenes such as a command center console and a conductor dispatching commands
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and friendly: a familiar team chat with a fleet of coding agents

branding.community_and_virality: No community or press about the brand found

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive mouse illustration theme on the site, but no press, merch or community evidence found.

outcome_analysis: Linzumi is an early Spring 2026 company with no outcome yet. The founder previously sold OneGraph to Netlify and worked at OpenAI on alignment, which fits the agent coordination wedge. The main risk is that chat and model vendors ship competing agent channels, as Slack did in August 2026.
notes: The company site lists backers Y Combinator, Matrix, SV Angel, Decibel, Pioneer Fund, Axiom Partners and Spot VC, with no amounts or dates. Aggregators conflict: Dealroom lists a 125k USD seed, VCBacked lists a pre-seed in May 2026 naming only YC, and one search summary mentioned a December 2025 seed that no primary source confirmed. All unverified, so no round is recorded. No competitor dated near the Spring 2026 batch was found in the competitor search; Slack Code came after it and is recorded under takeover risk. Completeness pass: The 125k dollar seed rests on a single database (Dealroom) with no date or investors; VCBacked's pre-seed dated 2026-05 naming YC may be the same round and is not recorded separately.
